mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 0.5% monthly increase in the CPIAUCSL index signals accelerating inflation expectations, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not rise >0.5% in any month, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 2% AND unemployment (UNRATE) remains below 3.5%, the combined effect of accommodative monetary policy and strong labor market signals drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS ≥ 2.0% or UNRATE ≥ 3.5% in the relevant period, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in the federal funds rate amplifies equity valuations by reducing policy tightness, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not fall below 2.0% in late-cycle expansion periods, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates growing economic demand, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not increase in at least two consecutive quarters, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening supply chains or demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains ≥ 100 in the relevant period, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in jobless claims (PAYEMS) above 150,000 in a month signals labor market stress, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate recession risks.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not exceed 150,000 in any month, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, simultaneous increases in GDP (GDPC1) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) signal robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 does not increase or UNRATE does not decrease in the relevant period, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
